judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is an h4 'Tópicos' (Topics) in the article footer, sitting just above the 'Compartilhar' (Share) heading. In the snapshot the only content under it is a single tag-style link, 'Dasa Educa', which is the article's category. The screenshot shows it as a small 'Tópicos' label over a 'Dasa Educa' chip. 'Topics' over a list of topic tags is exactly what that block is for, so the heading describes its purpose, and 2.4.6 asks for nothing more: headings need not be long or unique to be descriptive. The model was given the parent text 'Tópicos Dasa Educa Compartilhar', so it had what it needed and still got it wrong.
